title: 3 Tiny Things When You Can’t Do Anything
subtitle: Psych Cat’s micro-guide to surviving the heavy days
bodyHtml:
Hey human.

Some days you wake up and the world feels too heavy to stand up to.
That’s normal. Even I can’t chase the laser dot every day.

When you feel like you can’t do *anything*, try doing just one tiny thing.
Or three, if you have it in you.

  1. Drink water.
    Cats lick their fur all day — you can at least sip some water.
    Trust me, your brain runs better with it.
  2. Open a window.
    Fresh air does weird magic to stale thoughts.
    Plus, you might see a bird. Double win.
  3. Pet something soft.
    A cat, a pillow, your own hair. Doesn’t matter.
    Gentle touch tells your body you’re safe.

If that’s all you do today, that’s enough. You’re enough.
Rest your paws — tomorrow might feel lighter.
